description: Simulated benchmark; fictional provider assumptions; no real-world performance estimate.

assumptions.backup_distance: Same sampled per-trip distance for every replacement.
assumptions.family_allocation: Equal 20% shares by seed modulo 5; subsets can differ by one trip.
assumptions.deadline_allocation: Uniform seeded choice among tight, normal, relaxed.
assumptions.profile_scope: Family overrides apply to all providers in a trip; remaining fictional profile values unchanged.
assumptions.risk_label: Per assessment, failure means that ride does not arrive within the next 300 simulated seconds, including cancellation.
assumptions.risk_weighting: Assessment weighted; within-trip observations are correlated. B1 and B2 observe strategy-dependent ride populations; this is not an independent common-trace classifier test.
assumptions.counterfactual: Original driver continued with independent persisted per-ride draws through arrival/cancellation/horizon.
assumptions.false_warning_denominator: Trips where counterfactual original arrives by deadline.
assumptions.unnecessary_switch_denominator: Trips where counterfactual original arrives by deadline.
assumptions.time_metrics: Successful pickups and completed cancellation-to-rebooking intervals only; uncompleted intervals censored.
assumptions.fees: Illustrative cancellation-fee upper bounds, never actual charges.
assumptions.fare: Final confirmed fare minus initially offered fare; negative differences retained.
assumptions.initial_failure: All strategies receive same initial provider draws; failed initial booking is a failed pickup.
assumptions.B0: Wait; after confirmed driver cancellation approve manual rebook after configured delay; same fare and attempt caps.
assumptions.B1: Rules-v1 risk; stationary >120s requests cheapest eligible backup; immediate rebook after cancellation.
assumptions.B2: DefaultIntelligence rules-v2 and policy; simulated rider approves all proposals.
assumptions.timeout: Unfinished trips at horizon count as failed pickup.
assumptions.tuning: First split fraction of consecutive seeds, held out remainder; no automatic parameter tuning.
